name: claude-docs-course
tagline_zh: 把官方文档变成互动课程，边点边学不犯困。自带小测验和代码演示，学完立刻上手，比看文档快三倍。
tagline_en: Turn dry docs into clickable lessons with quizzes and live demos. Learn by doing, not reading. Master Claude APIs.
desc_en: Generate an interactive, self-contained HTML course on any Claude documentation topic. Use this skill when the user wants to create an interactive course, tutorial, or deep-dive walkthrough about a Claude feature, API concept, SDK pattern, or prompt engineering technique. why_zh: 同类工具只做摘要，它生成完整自包含HTML课程，内置交互练习，离线可开，学完即用。
why_en: Unlike summarizers, it builds a full standalone HTML course with embedded exercises—offline, interactive, and instantly usable.
